items.text: Malik Nabers officially active after murky Q (knee); decided ~2hrs pre-kick, family skipped due to uncertainty. Played SNF.
items.why: Late personal decision to play post-uncertainty.
items.implication: Start but decoy/risk-reward; monitor snaps post-knee.

items.text: ETR Sunday AM summary: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) EXPECTED TO PLAY. Corroborated active and debuted with rushing TD plus receiving work as ARI lead back.
items.why: Weekend reports and Rapoport expected; cleared inactives.
items.implication: Start as RB2/flex with lead role upside; monitor ankle workload split with Allgeier.
items.opportunity: Primary carries and routes in ARI backfield.

items.text: ETR: Rome Odunze (calf) EXPECTED TO PLAY. Schefter confirmed officially active vs CAR.
items.why: Expected per weekend reports; Schefter active confirmation.
items.implication: Full WR role in CHI offense; start with confidence.
items.opportunity: Routes and targets as key Bears receiver.

items.text: ETR: Alvin Kamara (knee) NOT EXPECTED TO PLAY. Rapoport: MCL sprain, full practice late week but not ready vs DET. Status links to Etienne projection bump.
items.why: Sources say not expected despite full participation; MCL.
items.implication: Sit Kamara; pivot to Etienne as clear lead back.

items.text: Combine Bowers (knee), AJ Brown (ankle), Darnold (hip), Stribling (ankle) with Sunday exits (Flowers/McConkey etc). Not a clean injury start; Nabers was murky then resolved active. Main slate news locked earlier.
items.why: Multiple key absences and early exits across slate.
items.implication: Adjust projections/ROS for affected; pivot handcuffs.

items.text: ETR post-game watch: Zay Flowers (hamstring) and Ladd McConkey (chest) left early; also Brian Thomas Jr shoulder, Kyler Murray concussion, others.
items.why: Exited games early; monitor practice next week.
items.implication: Check statuses for W2; possible limited or out.

items.text: Risk-reward because maybe decoy but starting Malik Nabers wherever owned after active confirmation.
items.why: Active despite late decision and knee concerns.
items.implication: Force into lineups; monitor actual snaps vs decoy.

items.text: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane ruled out wrist injury; initial fracture diagnosis, several weeks, further MRI.
items.why: Wrist injury mid-game; fracture confirmed sources.
items.implication: Multi-week absence; BAL WR depth thins.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining Ravens receivers.

items.text: A.J. Brown high ankle sprain: no surgery needed but sidelined 4-6 weeks (IR). Contrasted with other IR cases.
items.why: High ankle from W1; confirmed no surgery, multi-week.
items.implication: Sit ROS short-term; NE WR depth (Doubs etc.) rises.

items.text: After meniscus trim, Raiders believe realistic chance Brock Bowers misses only one game (OUT W1) and returns W2 at LAC. Team monitoring feel this week.
items.why: Meniscus trim Tuesday; optimistic short absence.
items.implication: Hold; stream Mayer short-term. W2 stash hopeful.

items.text: Kamara status directly affects Travis Etienne projection; with Kamara out, Etienne dominates NO backfield.
items.implication: Elevate Etienne to strong RB2/flex start.
items.opportunity: Carries, targets, red-zone as lead back.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout SZN well under way. Strong LOVE/start signal post-W1 production.
items.why: Early season usage and production validating preseason upside.
items.implication: Start/roster as TE1/stream with BAL role.
items.opportunity: Red-zone and target share in Ravens offense.

items.text: Buy low on Colston Loveland; preseason wanted max Bears offense exposure and that hasn't changed despite W1 target weirdness.
items.why: W1 volume dip is noise; still core to CHI passing.
items.implication: Acquire/hold as TE upside; start flex if needed.
items.opportunity: Routes with Williams/Odunze in Bears attack.

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks more real than not after preseason talk (Packers to new OC); validating role.
items.why: Preseason endorsement confirmed by early usage.
items.implication: Roster/start as WR depth with PHI opportunity.
